one_recommended_amendment.position: After restoration screening date, before concluding preservation lesson
one_recommended_amendment.text: The restored film also prompted fresh criticism. Writing after its Bologna screening, film historian Antti Alanen placed Prabha at its emotional centre and traced the family’s tensions through gender and generation. He admired its atmosphere and music while finding moments less intense—a response to the film itself, beyond its award history.
one_recommended_amendment.citation: Antti Alanen, Film Diary,27June2024, original AA section; https://anttialanenfilmdiary.blogspot.com/2024/06/maya-miriga-mirage-2024-restoration.html
one_recommended_amendment.value: Adds actual critical reception to a preservation essay presently grounded in curator/filmmaker accounts. Includes his qualification naturally, without forcing a negative counterweight.
one_recommended_amendment.budget: Proposed paragraph plus note well below200source-derivedwords; no directquotation.

findings: Existing DAMaN Hindi-version criticism and Bhukha director testimony remain correctly distinguished.

limits: Limited to opened sources and captured dossiers. No comprehensive review census, outreach, streaming or direct community consultation.
